prompt: Write a police officer's crash report narrative (about 120 words). Collision type: rear-end collision in Houston, Texas. The claimant was a driver and reported wrist fracture. Refer to people as Driver 1, Driver 2 or Passenger. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1214; do not mention it.)
text: Officer narrative. On arrival at the scene, I observed a rear-end collision involving two vehicles in the eastbound lanes of a Houston, Texas roadway. Driver 1 was operating the lead vehicle, which was stopped in traffic at the time of impact. Driver 2 was operating the following vehicle and stated that the vehicle did not stop in time before striking the rear of Driver 1's vehicle. A Passenger was seated in the front passenger seat of Driver 1's vehicle. Driver 1 reported pain in the left wrist and was transported by EMS for evaluation. Driver 2 and the Passenger reported no visible injuries. Both vehicles sustained rear and front damage and were driven from the roadway after tow was not required. Weather was clear and the road surface was dry. Driver 2 was issued a citation for following too closely. Statements were collected from all parties at the scene.
